description: Use to complete a booking, only after the customer agrees to the exact services, price and time. start comes from find_times; catalog_revision and expected_estimate_cents from the estimate they saw. Needs a phone or email so the business can reach them, and an address for a service at their place. A retry with the same request_key returns the same booking. Only status confirmed means booked; otherwise next says what the customer still has to do. Repeat with repeat and visits, or dates. Keep reply_token private: it is how the customer sees, moves or cancels it.

address.description: The street address, for a service at the customer's place

customer_name.description: Not needed when the sign-in or X-User-Name gives it, and likewise phone and email

dates.description: Exact starts for several visits, e.g. one per guest checkout

expected_estimate_cents.description: The total the customer agreed to

inquiry_id.description: An open conversation to book in, with its reply_token

only_who.description: Only this person: fewer times, but it stays with them

request_key.description: A private unique key: a retry with it never books twice

fields.description: Answers to the item's fields, by field id

quantity.description: How many: the party size for a table or a class

visits.description: With repeat: how many visits, including the first

who.description: Who they'd like, by name, from the catalog's team. A wish: someone else may take it, unless only_who

name: book
title: Book a time
